slides.title: Website hai, *enquiry nahi*? 5 cheezein check karo.
slides.sub: Apne phone pe khol ke, abhi. 5 minute.

slides.title: 1. *3 second* mein khulti hai?
slides.sub: Zyaadatar log phone pe aate hain. Slow = back button.

slides.title: 2. Pehli screen pe *kya + kahan*
slides.sub: "Welcome to our website" nahi. "Dental clinic, Sector 50 Gurgaon".
slides.box: Kya karte ho · kis sheher mein · kiske liye

slides.title: 3. *WhatsApp button* bina scroll
slides.sub: Customer ko dhoondhna pade to wo nahi dhoondhega.

slides.title: 4. *Price ka andaaza*
slides.sub: Exact nahi to range. Ya ek calculator. "Call for price" se log darte hain.

slides.title: 5. Form ka *jawab kitni der* mein?
slides.sub: Apni website pe khud form bharo. Reply kab aaya?

slides.title: Aapki website *kitne leads* gira rahi hai?
